testMode: Rapid repeated hard document navigation after DOMContentLoaded
hypothesis: Document-replacement/stream cancellation; attribution requires settled-navigation rerun and independent real client-navigation tests.
settledNavigationRerun: Passed: previously failing WebKit context plus remaining contexts; combined 216 route checks have no page errors or failed non-document responses.
realClientReturnRegression: Passed: 16 portfolio cases across Chromium/WebKit desktop/mobile, each popup return, client home/card reentry and native history return; isolated external document fixtures.
assessment: Consistent with test-induced document/stream cancellation, an inference rather than a proven application root cause. Raw warning retained; no application patch was made to hide it.
